name: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20)
description: The Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) dataset is a massive quantum-mechanical dataset curated by Meta AI and Carnegie Mellon University to accelerate renewable energy research and catalyst discovery. Comprising over 1.28 million molecular relaxation trajectories and 264 million density functional theory (DFT) single-point calculations across 55 chemical elements, it benchmarks machine learning models on structure-to-energy-and-forces (S2EF) and initial-structure-to-relaxed-energy (IS2RE) predictions.
